brief.summary: Risk aversion dominates: S&P futures down about 1% and Nasdaq 100 down about 1.6-2%, while Treasury yields fall across the curve as investors buy havens. Oil is sharply higher—Brent around $112 and WTI near $99.50—after Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities and reports of possible post-midterm U.S./Israel strikes. The Fed is expected to hold, though Williams floated one more 2026 hike and the two-year prices hikes. French fiscal stress is a major European risk, with OAT-Bund spreads near 170bp and French 10-year yields at multi-decade highs. AI/tech earnings are mixed: Meta and Lam Research fell despite beats, as capex and margin concerns bite. Consumer tone is mixed; cost of living and oil are key worries.
notable_quotes: Mega cap tanking, failing to extend the rally.
This is a test, not the appetite that exists about AI.
